title: SpeechSplice: Pronunciation Control in Encoder-Decoder LLM-based TTS by Replacing Encoder Hidden States
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027
summary: Most large language model (LLM)-based text-to-speech (TTS) methods offer no explicit function for correcting pronunciation. Consequently, these systems frequently mispronounce many everyday words, such as proper nouns, heteronyms, numerals, and domain-specific terms. While weight-editing or fine-tuning can mitigate this, these solutions risk quality degradation and must operate offline. We propose SpeechSplice, a training-free encoder-output replacement approach for pronunciation control in encoder-decoder LLM-based TTS. SpeechSplice replaces the encoder-output hidden states of a word with those of its intended reading. Cross-architecture and cross-lingual experiments cover ten public TTS systems in 17 model-language conditions. At the hidden state we replace, the intervention moves pronunciation toward the target reading more often when the generator reads the text through cross-attention than when text and speech share one self-attention sequence. In human evaluations, native-language listeners identified speech generated with SpeechSplice as realizing the target reading in 98.6-100.0% of judgments, while a separate study found no significant naturalness difference from unmodified synthesis. By clarifying the conditions under which pronunciation correction succeeds, this study offers an empirical basis for investigating pronunciation control in LLM-based TTS architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出SpeechSplice方法，通过替换编码器输出实现无须训练和微调的发音校正，在10个TTS系统17种模型-语言条件下验证，人类评估中98.6-100%判断为目标读音且自然度无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的TTS方法缺乏显式发音校正功能，频繁误读专有名词、异形同音词、数字和专业术语等日常词汇；权重编辑或微调方案可能降低质量且需离线操作。
AI.method: 训练无关的编码器输出替换方法，将目标词汇的编码器输出隐状态替换为其正确读音的隐状态；对比跨注意力架构与自注意力序列架构下的替换效果差异。
AI.result: 跨10个TTS系统17种条件下的实验显示：在生成器通过交叉注意力读取文本时，干预更有效将发音转向目标读音；人类评估中98.6-100%判断为正确读音，自然度评分与未修改合成无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 阐明了发音校正成功的条件，为基于LLM的TTS架构中的发音控制研究提供了实证基础。

title: BiSAT: Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization for Speech Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, Y. Lu and L. Wang are co-first authors
summary: Speech language models (LMs) generate speech as sequences of discrete tokens, requiring tokenizers that preserve both acoustic detail and linguistic content at a low bitrate. Semanticenhanced tokenizers may discard acoustic detail, whereas acousticoriented tokenizers retain acoustic variation that hinders language modeling. Unified tokenizers combine both, but encoding them within a single feature space can cause interference, and existing methods typically align acoustic features to fixed targets from a frozen semantic teacher. We propose Bidirectionally Aligned Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization (BiSAT), a unified framework with separate acoustic and semantic branches coupled by a shared-index mechanism. During training, each branch has its own encoder, codebook, and decoder, and at every frame a shared index minimizes the combined quantization error across both branches. BiSAT thus learns acoustic and semantic representations in separate continuous spaces while producing a single discrete code stream, jointly optimizing both encoders without fixed semantic teachers. Built on BiSAT, BiSAT-TTS pairs an autoregressive text-speech LM with a conditional flow-matching acoustic decoder for zero-shot text-to-speech. Reconstruction, frozen-code understanding, and diagnostic analyses show that BiSAT preserves accessible linguistic and acoustic structure in a low-bitrate single stream, generalizes strongly to in-thewild and out-of-domain speech, and learns complementary paired codebooks. BiSAT-TTS matches or surpasses state-of-the-art speech LM-based TTS baselines with less training data, demonstrating that accessible code structure, not reconstruction quality alone, benefits autoregressive speech modeling. The audio demos are available at https://seekmind-lab.github.io/bisat-demo.

AI.tldr: 提出BiSAT，一种双向对齐的语义-声学分词框架，通过共享索引机制联合优化声学和语义分支，在低码率单码流中保留可访问的语言和声学结构，并基于BiSAT构建BiSAT-TTS实现零样本文本转语音，性能超越SOTA基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音分词器存在语义增强型丢失声学细节、声学导向型保留过多声学变化阻碍语言建模、统一型在单一特征空间编码导致干扰等问题，且现有方法通常将声学特征对齐到冻结的语义教师模型的固定目标上。
AI.method: 提出BiSAT，包含独立的声学和语义分支，每个分支有自己的编码器、码本和解码器，通过共享索引机制在每一帧最小化两个分支的组合量化误差，同时优化两个编码器而无需固定的语义教师模型。基于BiSAT构建BiSAT-TTS，结合自回归文本-语音LM和条件流匹配声学解码器。
AI.result: BiSAT在低码率单码流中保留了可访问的语言和声学结构，对野外和域外语音具有强泛化能力，学习了互补的配对码本。BiSAT-TTS用更少的训练数据匹配或超越了基于语音LM的SOTA TTS基线。
AI.conclusion: 可访问的码本结构（而非仅重建质量）有利于自回归语音建模，BiSAT为语音分词和TTS提供了有效统一框架。

title: Which Layer to Trust? Layer Selection in Frozen Speech Encoders for Singing-Voice Deepfake Detection under Signal Corruption
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Under review at C4AI4C @ ICASSP 2027. Hurt and Yang equal contributors
summary: Frozen self-supervised speech encoders have been frequently used for audio deepfake detection. However, the layers are usually chosen from a development set. We examine this choice for singing-voice deepfake detection on CtrSVDD. We train one detection head per layer, plus a learned layer mix, on frozen XEUS (3-4 seeds) and XLS-R (2 seeds). We test on clean audio and under noise, reverberation and lossy coding. On clean audio, the middle layers beat the last layer in both encoders and the learned mix does not beat the best single layer. The layer chosen on the development set is 2.3 (XEUS) and 4.1 (XLS-R) percentage points of EER worse than the best test layer. Under noise and coding, XEUS's best layers stay in the middle, while under reverberation its upper layers catch up, whereas XLS-R's best layer moves shallower. In an exploratory analysis, XEUS detects a commercial synthesis attack best with an earlier layer, especially under noise. The layer therefore cannot be chosen reliably on an in-domain development set and clean audio alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了冻结自监督语音编码器在歌声深度伪造检测中的层选择问题，发现中间层优于最后一层，但基于开发集选择的层在测试集上表现不佳，且层选择受噪声和混响等条件影响显著。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常基于开发集经验性地选择冻结语音编码器的层，但缺乏对层选择鲁棒性和泛化性的系统分析，尤其是在歌声深度伪造检测这一任务中。
AI.method: 使用冻结的 XEUS 和 XLS-R 编码器，为每一层训练独立的检测头，同时训练一个可学习的层混合模块。在 CtrSVDD 数据集上评估，测试条件包括干净音频、噪声、混响和有损编码。
AI.result: 干净音频下中间层优于最后一层，但可学习混合未超过最佳单层；基于开发集选择的层在测试集上分别比最佳测试层差 2.3%（XEUS）和 4.1%（XLS-R）的 EER；噪声和编码条件下中间层仍最佳，混响下 XEUS 的上层表现提升而 XLS-R 的最佳层变浅；商业合成攻击的检测偏好更浅的层。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖域内开发集和干净音频无法可靠选择最优层，层选择需考虑攻击类型和噪声条件等因素。

title: Characterizing Frozen SSL Encoders and Backends for Cross-Domain Speech Deepfake Detection
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at IEEE ISM 2026 (28th International Symposium on Multimedia) Regular Paper
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) encoders are the dominant front end for speech deepfake detection, and the prevailing recipe fine-tunes the full encoder on a small spoofing corpus, maximizing in-domain accuracy at the cost of known degradation under domain shift. Taking a recent cross-attention fusion of SSL and constant-Q cepstral features as a fixed reference recipe, we freeze its encoder and ask which encoder and which backend behave best across domains. We cross two frozen encoders, the massively multilingual XEUS and Wav2Vec2 XLSR-53, with two backends, multi-head factorized attentive (MHFA) pooling and AASIST, and evaluate on ASVspoof 2019 LA, ASVspoof 2021 LA and DF, In-the-Wild (ITW), and ASVspoof 5, training every system in one pipeline over three seeds. We report three findings. First, encoder and backend interact: MHFA suits the stronger encoder, while AASIST recovers more from and stabilizes the weaker one. Second, within this recipe, the frozen encoder produces large, repeatable differences. With MHFA, frozen XEUS lowers error relative to frozen XLSR-53 by 58-77% on LA21, DF21, and ASV5, and more modestly on ITW. This ordering persists in a matched-aggregation ablation, and a capacity-matched WavLM Large diagnostic shows that parameter count alone does not explain XLSR-53's weaker performance. Third, against a three-seed fine-tuned baseline, frozen XEUS updates under 0.4M parameters versus 316M, wins on ASVspoof 5 (in EER and min-DCF) and modestly on LA21, trails on DF21 and ITW, and shows lower seed variation on three of the four out-of-domain sets.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了在语音深度伪造检测中，冻结自监督学习（SSL）编码器并结合不同后端的方法。通过对比XEUS和Wav2Vec2 XLSR-53两种冻结编码器，搭配MHFA和AASIST两种后端，在多个数据集上评测发现：编码器与后端存在交互作用；冻结XEUS编码器性能显著优于XLSR-53；冻结XEUS在参数效率极高的情况下，性能接近甚至部分超越全微调基线，且域外泛化更稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音深度伪造检测方法通常对完整的SSL编码器进行微调，虽然域内精度高，但存在域偏移下性能下降的问题。为了提升跨域泛化能力，同时大幅降低可训练参数量，研究者探索固定（冻结）编码器、仅训练轻量后端的方法。
AI.method: 采用固定参考方案：交叉融合SSL和常数Q倒谱特征。冻结两种大规模多语言编码器（XEUS和Wav2Vec2 XLSR-53），搭配两种后端（多头分解注意力池化MHFA和AASIST）。在ASVspoof 2019 LA、ASVspoof 2021 LA和DF、In-the-Wild (ITW)、ASVspoof 5五个数据集上，使用同一训练流程和三个随机种子进行系统评估。
AI.result: 1）编码器与后端存在交互：MHFA更适合强编码器XEUS，AASIST能更好恢复弱编码器XLSR-53的性能并提高稳定性。2）冻结编码器带来巨大且可重复的性能差异：搭配MHFA时，冻结XEUS相比冻结XLSR-53在LA21、DF21和ASV5上错误率降低58-77%，ITW上降低幅度较小；参数量一致性的消融实验和容量匹配的WavLM Large诊断排除了参数量差异的主导作用。3）相比全微调基线（约316M参数），冻结XEUS仅更新不到0.4M参数，在ASVspoof 5上EER和min-DCF均胜出，LA21上小幅领先，DF21和ITW上稍逊，且在四个域外数据集中三个的种子方差更低。
AI.conclusion: 冻结大规模SSL编码器结合轻量后端是一种高效、跨域泛化能力强的语音深度伪造检测方案。其中XEUS编码器显著优于XLSR-53，且与MHFA后端搭配效果最佳。该方法在参数效率（0.4M vs 316M可训练参数）和域外稳定性方面具有优势，部分场景下甚至超越全微调基线。

title: S$2$SCORE: A Textless Unified Evaluation Metric for Speech-to-Speech Translation Systems
comment: Accepted for presentation at the IEEE Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026, Palermo, Italy
summary: Evaluating speech-to-speech translation (S$2$ST) systems requires assessing multiple dimensions of translated speech, including semantic adequacy, speaker similarity, and acoustic naturalness. Existing approaches are largely text-based, relying on ASR transcripts and primarily assessing semantic adequacy, while other dimensions require separate metrics. We propose S$2$SCORE, a unified text-free evaluation framework that jointly models these dimensions within a multi-task architecture and produces a human-calibrated overall quality score. S$2$SCORE is trained using supervision derived from established evaluation models, enabling scalable learning without direct human annotations. Evaluated across five language pairs, S$2$SCORE shows strong agreement with human judgments, independent reference metrics, and the training supervision metrics, indicating robust generalization. The reference-free variant, S$2$SCORE-QE, consistently outperforms S$2$SCORE-REF and achieves stronger semantic adequacy prediction than BLASER~$2.0$.

AI.tldr: S2SCORE是一个用于语音到语音翻译（S2ST）评估的统一无文本评估框架。它通过多任务架构联合建模语义充分性、说话人相似性和声学自然度，并生成与人类校准的整体质量评分。该框架利用已有评估模型的监督信号进行可扩展学习，无需直接人工标注。在五个语言对上，S2SCORE与人类判断、独立参考指标及训练监督指标均表现出高度一致性。其无参考变体S2SCORE-QE一致优于有参考变体S2SCORE-REF，且在语义充分性预测上超越BLASER 2.0。
AI.motivation: 现有S2ST评估方法多基于文本，依赖ASR转录，主要评估语义充分性，而其他维度（如说话人相似性、声学自然度）需要单独的指标，缺乏统一、无文本的多维度评估框架。
AI.method: 提出S2SCORE，一个无文本的统一评估框架，采用多任务架构联合建模语义充分性、说话人相似性和声学自然度，并输出与人类校准的整体质量评分。训练使用源自已有评估模型的监督信号，无需直接人工标注。
AI.result: 在五个语言对上，S2SCORE与人类判断、独立参考指标以及训练监督指标均表现出强一致性。无参考变体S2SCORE-QE优于有参考变体S2SCORE-REF，并在语义充分性预测上超越BLASER 2.0。
AI.conclusion: S2SCORE是一个有效的统一无文本S2ST评估框架，能够联合建模多个关键维度，具有强泛化能力，其无参考变体在多个维度上表现最佳。

title: Voice Agents: From Auditory Intelligence to Auditory Agency
summary: Voice systems increasingly combine streaming speech, persistent state, reasoning, tool use, and embodied control. Once these functions share a runtime, spoken input can change digital or physical state, and recognition or response quality alone no longer characterizes the system. This article studies the interfaces through which spoken evidence becomes consequential. \emph{Auditory intelligence} denotes the capabilities required to perceive, understand, coordinate, and generate spoken interaction; \emph{auditory agency} denotes the causal path from that interaction to stateful decisions and observable consequences. The \emph{commitment boundary} marks where revisable auditory evidence becomes persistent state, a plan, or an executable request. \emph{Agency closure} then follows an authorized action through observation, verification, recovery or compensation, and communication of the outcome. Evidence from full-duplex interaction, reasoning, memory, tools, embodiment, and human control shows a consistent systems-level mismatch: integration is advancing faster than end-to-end observation of what the integrated system actually does. The resulting design problem is to preserve a trace from spoken evidence to consequence while keeping commitment, execution, and verification attributable.

AI.tldr: 语音系统正从单点识别向集成推理、工具调用与具身控制的智能体演化，但端到端可观测性严重滞后于集成速度，亟需建立从语音证据到状态化后果的可归因追踪框架。
AI.motivation: 语音系统已突破纯识别范畴，集成了流式语音、持久状态、推理、工具调用和具身控制，但现有评估和设计方法仍停留在识别/响应质量层面，无法表征系统实际产生的后果与责任归属。
AI.method: 提出了四个核心概念形式化该问题：（1）听觉智能——感知、理解、协调与生成语音交互所需能力；（2）听觉能动性——从语音交互到状态化决策与可观察后果的因果路径；（3）承诺边界——可修正的听觉证据变为持久状态/计划/可执行请求的界限；（4）能动性闭合——授权操作经观察、验证、恢复/补偿、结果通报的完整闭环。
AI.result: 通过全双工交互、推理、记忆、工具、具身化和人类控制等多案例分析，发现一个一致的系统级失配：集成速度远快于端到端观测整个系统实际行为的能力。
AI.conclusion: 核心设计问题是在保持承诺、执行与验证可归因的前提下，保留从语音证据到后果的完整追踪链路。

title: Speech Emotion Recognition Across Languages: Prosodic Patterns and Self-Supervised Learning
comment: Chinese Journal of Phonetics, Vol. 24
summary: This study investigates the prosodic patterns of emotional speech across Chinese (CN), German (DE), and English (EN), with a focus on acoustic characteristics. Using ANOVA and mixed-effects modeling, we reveal cross-linguistic and emotion-specific prosodic patterns. A comparative analysis of Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) performance demonstrates that humans outperform Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) models in cross-lingual tasks, while SSL models show significant improvement in cross-lingual SER through an efficient fine-tuning process, achieving performance competitive with native human speakers. The study also analyzes the performance of Speech Emotion Diarization (SED) between models and humans, highlighting the effectiveness of SSL models in transfer learning scenarios. These findings emphasize the interplay between universal prosodic features (e.g., intensity, pitch) and language-specific factors. Moreover, the SSL model's outstanding performance indicates the potential value of these acoustic features in emotion processing, implying possible advancements in cross-lingual emotion recognition through refined training techniques.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了汉语、德语和英语三种语言中情绪语音的韵律模式，发现人类在跨语言情绪识别任务中优于自监督学习模型，但通过高效微调，SSL模型性能可接近母语者水平；同时分析了语音情绪分割的表现，强调了韵律特征的普适性与语言特异性之间的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 探究跨语言（汉语、德语、英语）情绪语音的韵律模式及其声学特征，比较人类与自监督学习模型在跨语言语音情绪识别中的表现差异。
AI.method: 采用方差分析和混合效应模型揭示跨语言和情绪特异性的韵律模式；通过比较人类与SSL模型在跨语言SER任务中的表现，以及分析SED的性能差异进行评估。
AI.result: 人类在跨语言SER任务中优于SSL模型；但通过高效微调，SSL模型性能显著提升，达到与母语者竞争的水平；SSL模型在迁移学习场景下的SED任务中表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: 强调了强度、音高等普适韵律特征与语言特异性因素之间的相互作用；SSL模型的优异表现表明其声学特征在情绪处理中的潜在价值，可能通过改进训练技术推动跨语言情绪识别的进步。

title: Preserving Prosody in Speaker Anonymization
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Effective prosody modeling is essential in natural speech generation applications, but complications arise in speaker anonymization, since speaker attributes are present in acoustic correlates of prosody. Our work aims to improve previous reported tradeoffs between effective speaker obfuscation and preservation of prosodic content. To this end, we integrate an existing pretrained privacy-preserving prosody encoder into a speech synthesis model, enabling prosody-preserving speaker anonymization. By conditioning speech generation on prosody features, we find that human subjects more reliably perceive intended prosodic meaning, while anonymization performance is competitive with previous work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将预训练的隐私保护韵律编码器集成到语音合成模型中，在保持韵律内容的同时实现说话人匿名化，改善了说话人混淆与韵律保留之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的说话人匿名化方法在有效混淆说话人身份与保留韵律内容之间存在权衡，因为韵律的声学关联中包含说话人属性。
AI.method: 将预训练的隐私保护韵律编码器集成到语音合成模型中，使用韵律特征条件化语音生成。
AI.result: 人类受试者能更可靠地感知预期的韵律含义，同时匿名化性能与此前工作相当。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够实现韵律保留的说话人匿名化，有效改善了此前报告的性能权衡。

title: Granary-v2: Scalable Multilingual Speech Data Curation for Predictable and Controllable Model Outputs
comment: The first three authors contributed equally. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Granary-v2
summary: Speech-language models that follow instructions need training data that connects the same recording to different output forms and tasks. We present Granary-v2, a multilingual speech dataset and reusable curation system that provides a data foundation for these models. Granary-v2 extends Granary-v1 with aligned transcript variants and instruction-target pairs for multi-task speech-language training. Language coverage increases from 25 to 48 languages. Built with NeMo Curator, the system combines language-dependent ASR labeling, transcript improvement, and text label generation. It produces aligned targets for speech-faithful transcription, written forms with and without disfluencies, and code-switched transcription. Additional targets include transcript-derived captions and question-answer pairs, with context and translations for selected records. The full processed collection contains approximately 843,600 unique audio hours, with translations covering about 142,800 hours into English and about 55k hours of English audio into 31 target languages. We evaluate label-quality filtering with two English Transformer-TDT models under the same training-step budget. Filtering reduces the unweighted mean word error rate across nine benchmarks from 4.91% to 4.67%, with improvements on six benchmarks. We also report curation throughput and downstream ASR and speech translation results from Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe, which uses Granary-v2 as part of its training data. We release the Granary-v2 pipeline, built with NeMo Curator, and model training recipes as open source. We release a public subset of the generated labels and instruction-target pairs through Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: Granary-v2是一个多语言语音数据集与可复用的策展系统，覆盖48种语言，包含约84.36万小时音频，支持语音忠实转录、书面形式、代码转换、字幕和问答对等多任务训练，通过标签质量过滤将英文词错误率从4.91%降至4.67%，并开源了策展流程与模型训练配方。
AI.motivation: 语音-语言模型需要连接同一录音与不同输出形式和任务的训练数据，现有数据缺乏多任务对齐的多语言资源。
AI.method: 基于NeMo Curator构建可复用策展系统，结合语言相关的ASR标注、转录改进和文本标签生成，产出对齐的转录变体与指令-目标对。
AI.result: 覆盖48种语言，约84.36万小时音频，其中14.28万小时有英文翻译，5.5万小时英文音频翻译成31种目标语言；标签质量过滤使英文词错误率从4.91%降至4.67%，在9个基准中的6个上表现提升。
AI.conclusion: Granary-v2为多任务语音-语言模型提供了大规模多语言数据基础，开源了策展流程、模型配方和部分标签数据，有助于推动该领域研究。

title: NAVIQUAL-XR: Finding the Sweet Spot of a Live Music Environment in Augmented Reality
comment: Submitted to ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications, and Applications (TOMM)
summary: Augmented Reality (AR) enables immersive spatial audio experiences that extend conventional stereo and head-tracked listening to six degrees-of-freedom (6-DoF) navigation. However, evaluating listener Quality of Experience (QoE) remains a key challenge due to the real-time and dynamic adaptations of the content in AR environments. To address this challenge, we propose NAVIQUAL-XR, an objective model to find the "sweet spot" in AR live music environments validated by subjective tests. We recruited 25 listeners who navigated 12 AR environments of various scene set ups under auditory and audio-visual modalities. We analyzed their navigation trajectories and recorded their final locations and directions as their subjective sweet spots. We then produced subjective maps that identified the location and direction with the optimal QoE in an AR environment. Furthermore, we benchmarked key objective metrics that predict these sweet spots through similarity metrics with the subjective maps. We found that localization quality derived from BINAQUAL, an objective metric designed for binaural audio, outperformed signal-to-noise ratio in closely predicting the sweet spot. This suggests that phase-based cues play a more important role on perceived QoE in AR environments than intensity-based cues. NAVIQUAL-XR provides new insights into listener behavior and preferences in AR environments, demonstrating the potential of objective metrics to predict the subjective experience, and guiding the design of future immersive audio systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NAVIQUAL-XR客观模型，通过主观实验和轨迹分析预测增强现实环境中听众的"最佳体验点"，发现双耳定位质量优于信噪比，表明相位线索比强度线索对感知体验质量更重要。
AI.motivation: 增强现实中的沉浸式音频体验评估面临实时动态适配挑战，缺乏有效的客观预测模型。
AI.method: 招募25名听众在12种AR场景（听觉/视听模态）中导航，记录轨迹与最终位置方向作为主观最佳点，构建主观地图并对比客观指标。
AI.result: 双耳定位质量（BINAQUAL指标）在预测最佳体验点上优于信噪比，相位线索比强度线索对感知QoE更重要。
AI.conclusion: NAVIQUAL-XR展示了客观指标预测主观体验的潜力，为未来沉浸式音频系统设计提供指导。

title: LiveAudio: From Bidirectional to Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-Time Streaming Video-to-Audio Generation
comment: 23 pages, 12 tables, 14 figures
summary: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at https://streamaudio.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出了LiveAudio，一种将双向视频到音频模型转换为流式生成框架的方法，实现在视频播放时实时生成高质量同步音频，在VGGSound上性能优于现有流式模型，实时因子0.79，首帧延迟143ms。
AI.motivation: 现有视频到音频模型多为双向模型，需观察完整片段才能生成音频，无法满足实时交互需求（如直播、游戏等）。
AI.method: 采用渐进式因果微调（progressive causal fine-tuning）和蒸馏（distillation）技术，将预训练的双向模型转换为逐块流式生成器，每个音频块仅依赖已播放的视频内容，且只需少量采样步骤。
AI.result: 在VGGSound数据集上，LiveAudio在音频质量和同步性上均优于现有流式模型；同步性甚至超过了其基础的原始双向模型。在单张A100 GPU上实时因子为0.79，首帧延迟143ms。
AI.conclusion: LiveAudio成功将双向模型转化为高效流式生成器，在保持音频质量的同时实现了实时同步生成，为交互式视频音频生成提供了可行方案。

title: SWIFT: A Handcrafted, Arithmetic-Minimal FPGA Engine for Real-Time Audio Deepfake Detection
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables, 1 algorithm. Accepted at ICISS 2026. Chirantan Banerjee and Soumita Chatterjee are joint first authors
summary: Generative voice cloning threatens voice-based authentication, yet current deepfake detectors rely on power-hungry, high-precision models unsuited to edge hardware. We present SWIFT (Streaming Whiten-Integer Forensic Trust-Engine), a handcrafted detector that works in the high-frequency noise domain where synthesis artifacts concentrate. A first-order integer high-pass residual drives nine families of fixed-point descriptors, among them integer lifting-wavelet cepstral quantiles, Mahalanobis anomaly distances, Poincaré phase-space geometry, and phase jitter, fused by calibrated gradient-boosted trees and a sparse L1-regularised meta-learner. Under leakage-controlled nested cross-validation, with one shared preprocessing chain for real and fake audio, this reference model reaches accuracy of up to 99.86% and an Equal Error Rate (EER) as low as 0.03% across eight benchmarks. Its integer front-end and a fixed-point linear classifier run on the programmable logic of a PYNQ-Z2 (Zynq-7020) board, with a 7.85 microseconds per-frame datapath latency (127.4k frames/s) at 1.734 W and 11.2% LUT utilisation. Integer-only audio deepfake feature extraction is thus feasible at the edge without pretrained neural models or floating-point units.

AI.tldr: SWIFT是一种纯整数运算的轻量级语音深度伪造检测器，在边缘硬件（PYNQ-Z2）上达到99.86%准确率、0.03% EER，帧级延迟仅7.85微秒，功耗1.734W。
AI.motivation: 现有语音深度伪造检测器依赖高精度、高功耗的深度学习模型，无法在资源受限的边缘硬件上部署。
AI.method: 在高频噪声域设计手工特征（整数提升小波倒谱分位数、马氏异常距离、庞加莱相空间几何、相位抖动等），经梯度提升树和L1稀疏元学习器融合，并全部采用整数定点运算实现。
AI.result: 在8个基准上达到99.86%准确率、0.03% EER；在PYNQ-Z2上帧延迟7.85微秒（12.74万帧/秒），功耗1.734W，LUT利用率仅11.2%。
AI.conclusion: 无需预训练神经网络或浮点单元，纯整数运算的语音深度伪造特征提取可在边缘端可行实现。

title: CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
comment: Accepted at AAAI-27, Innovative Applications of AI (IAAI) track, poster. Aditya Mishra and Thanish Bolla are co-first authors. 10 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables
summary: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spanning 60.46 hours, CAST reduces normalized WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and subtitle edit rate from 254.2 to 221.9 min/hour against the WhisperX pipeline, and improves deletion rate by 11% on public datasets. We also present the behavior of each stage in the pipeline. CAST entered the production speech-to-text (STT) stage of our CC pipeline in late August 2026; we report the evaluation evidence and path to full-scale operation.

AI.tldr: 提出CAST集成管道，通过分层VAD和幻觉检测修复机制提升长视频字幕生成质量，在内部测试集上将WER从6.99%降至5.36%。
AI.motivation: 长视频（尤其是含音乐、口音、串扰和噪声的内容）的字幕生成质量受限于VAD的单次检测缺陷，导致漏检低能量语音或产生幻觉与重复，亟需更鲁棒的分层处理方案。
AI.method: 构建CAST管道：融合Whisper large-v3、分层VAD（对拒绝片段进行语义和声学保留复查）、语言识别、歌词路由以及幻觉检测与修复模块，在单一NVIDIA L4 GPU上运行。
AI.result: 在100个内部资产（60.46小时）上，归一化WER从6.99%降至5.36%，字幕编辑率从254.2降至221.9 min/hour；在公开数据集上删除率提升11%。
AI.conclusion: CAST已于2026年8月下旬投入生产STT阶段，实验证据支持其达到全规模运营的标准。

title: What Do Sound Event Embeddings Reveal? Auditing Speaker Leakage in Audio Representations
summary: Pretrained audio embeddings are increasingly used as intermediate representations for sound event detection (SED) and other always-on acoustic sensing tasks. While these representations are selected for their utility on downstream tasks, they may also retain sensitive information unrelated to their intended purpose, creating privacy risks even when raw audio is not exposed. In this work, we present an empirical framework for auditing privacy leakage from pretrained audio embeddings using two complementary approaches. First, we quantify representation-level leakage by measuring statistical dependence between an audio embedding and a representation specialized for encoding sensitive information. Second, we measure attack-level leakage by training lightweight adversarial probes to recover sensitive attributes directly from the embedding. We apply this framework to four widely used audio representations (CLAP, PANNs, AST, and YAMNet) and evaluate leakage of speaker identity and gender. We found that speaker identification balanced accuracy ranges from $0.43$ to $0.72$, while gender information is also strongly recoverable. Moreover, representation-level and attack-based measurements exhibit consistent trends, with CLAP leaking the most and YAMNet leaking the lest speaker identity. These results demonstrate that intermediate audio representations are not inherently privacy-preserving interfaces and motivate privacy leakage as an explicit criterion, alongside downstream utility, when selecting representations for acoustic sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个经验框架，用于审计预训练音频嵌入中的隐私泄露风险，通过表征级和攻击级两种互补方法评估四种广泛使用的音频表征（CLAP、PANNs、AST、YAMNet）在说话人身份和性别属性上的泄露程度，发现这些中间表征并非天然的隐私保护接口，CLAP泄露最多，YAMNet泄露最少。
AI.motivation: 预训练音频嵌入虽被广泛用作声音事件检测等声学传感任务的中间表征，但它们可能保留与任务无关的敏感信息，即使在原始音频未暴露的情况下也造成隐私风险。
AI.method: 提出了一个经验隐私审计框架，包含两种互补方法：(1) 表征级泄露——衡量音频嵌入与专门编码敏感信息的表征之间的统计依赖性；(2) 攻击级泄露——训练轻量对抗探针直接从嵌入中恢复敏感属性。
AI.result: 在说话人身份识别上，平衡准确率范围为0.43到0.72；性别信息也高度可恢复。CLAP泄露最多，YAMNet泄露最少；表征级与攻击级测量结果趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 预训练音频嵌入并非天然的隐私保护接口，在选择用于声学传感系统的表征时，应将隐私泄露作为与下游效用并列的明确考量标准。

title: SonicRender: Structured and Time-Grounded Rendering of Multi-Event Audio Scene Generation
summary: While unified audio generators can synthesize speech, music, and sound effects within a single model, producing a plausible mixture is only part of the challenge: a complex scene request also specifies which events occur, who produces them, and when they are heard. To satisfy these compositional constraints in a single generation pass, we present SonicRender, a unified multi-event audio renderer. Its Temporal Audio Scene Graph (TASG) binds persistent source identities to localized speech, music, ambience, and sound-effect events, together with their content, acoustic roles, relations, and timestamped windows. We further introduce AbsTime, which supplies the audio latent stream with absolute-frame coordinates and valid-canvas duration. Through joint text-audio attention and conditional flow matching, the renderer learns to realize structured, timed scenes as coherent mixtures. On the MMAG timestamp benchmark, SonicRender achieves speech/sound F1 scores of 0.79/0.60, exceeding the strongest reported scores in our comparison. On our SceneMix evaluation, it attains 85.4% all-event recall, 83.9% window-hit rate, and 95.7% speaker accuracy. Subjective study further demonstrates significant improvements over all five comparison systems in both perceived audio quality and scene realization. Results across speech, general audio, music, multi-event load, and temporal-grounding analyses establish precise, composition-aware audio rendering within a unified generator. Demo page: https://caiyunrui.github.io/SonicRender.

AI.tldr: SonicRender 是一个统一的多事件音频渲染器，通过引入时间音频场景图（TASG）和绝对帧时间编码（AbsTime），在单一生成过程中实现对语音、音乐、音效等多事件的组合约束生成，并在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 统一音频生成模型虽能合成语音、音乐和音效的混合结果，但复杂场景请求还需满足事件发生内容、生产者身份及时间等组合约束，现有方法难以在一次生成中同时满足这些条件。
AI.method: 提出 Temporal Audio Scene Graph (TASG) 绑定持久声源身份、事件内容、声学角色、关系和时间戳窗口；引入 AbsTime 为音频潜在流提供绝对帧坐标和有效画布时长；通过联合文本-音频注意力与条件流匹配学习生成结构化、带时间标记的场景混合。
AI.result: 在 MMAG 时间戳基准上语音/音效 F1 达 0.79/0.60，超过已有最高结果；SceneMix 评估中全事件召回率 85.4%、窗口命中率 83.9%、说话人准确率 95.7%；主观测试在感知音频质量和场景实现上显著优于五个对比系统。
AI.conclusion: SonicRender 在语音、通用音频、音乐、多事件负载和时间定位分析中均实现了精确的、组合感知的音频渲染，证明了统一生成器处理复杂场景组合约束的能力。

title: AIRPiano: Piano Score Following with Tabletop Hand Gestures
summary: AIRPiano aims to bring sound to the common practice of rehearsing piano music on a tabletop. Guided by a known score, users make piano-like finger movements on a flat surface without reproducing absolute keyboard positions. The score supplies pitches, while hand motion determines which score events to play and when. We formulate this interaction as online alignment between tabletop hand motion and symbolic score events. To address the ambiguity of tabletop motion, its differences from piano-playing motion, and the scarcity of aligned motion-score data, we develop motion and score representations, build a data processing pipeline, and train a Transformer with supervised attention on existing piano performance recordings. We further design a streaming inference framework that combines local alignment predictions with sequence tracking for real-time interaction. We construct two evaluation sets, VSF-Piano and VSF-Tabletop, to assess alignment on piano and tabletop performances, respectively. After a post-hoc global timing adjustment, AIRPiano achieves a mean chord alignment rate of 74% within a 133 ms tolerance on the paired subset of VSF-Tabletop, compared with 79% on VSF-Piano.

AI.tldr: AIRPiano 提出了一种基于桌面手势与乐谱在线对齐的交互系统，用户可在桌面上模拟弹钢琴动作，系统通过Transformer和流式推理实现实时音符对齐，在桌面数据集上达到74%的和弦对齐率。
AI.motivation: 将日常桌面排练钢琴动作（无键盘位置）转化为实际声音，解决桌面手势模糊、与真实弹奏动作差异大、对齐动作-乐谱数据稀缺等问题。
AI.method: 采用在线对齐框架：设计手势与乐谱表示；构建数据处理流水线；在现有钢琴演奏数据上训练带监督注意力机制的Transformer；提出结合局部对齐预测与序列追踪的流式推理方法。
AI.result: 在VSF-Tabletop子集上，经全局时序调整后，平均和弦对齐率达74%（容差133 ms），在VSF-Piano上为79%。
AI.conclusion: AIRPiano验证了桌面无键盘手势与乐谱实时对齐的可行性，为虚拟钢琴练习提供了一种新交互方式。

title: Scoring L2 Pronunciation Without Synthesis: Counterfactual Velocity Contrast in Frozen Flow-Matching TTS
summary: Flow-matching text-to-speech (TTS) models learn how native speakers realize a text, yet this knowledge is used only for synthesis. We show that a frozen TTS model can score non-native (L2) pronunciation without generating audio. For a learner utterance, we compare the model's velocity-prediction error under the target text with its error under a counterfactual text (dropped or swapped) on the same noised input; the difference behaves like a generative goodness-of-pronunciation score. The signal is confined to a narrow band of high-noise timesteps, which a native-speech criterion locates and a closed-form rule transfers across backbones. On speaker-disjoint speechocean762, four frozen TTS models reach $r{=}0.58$--$0.63$ with human scores, within the range of zero-shot ASR and phone-level baselines, and adding them to those baselines in a label-free fusion raises $r$ from $0.698$ to $0.757$. Cached frame scores also flag word-level errors at no extra TTS cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用冻结的语音合成(TTS)模型对非母语(L2)发音进行评分，无需生成音频。通过比较模型在目标文本与反事实文本下的速度预测误差差异，得到生成式发音良好度评分。在非重叠说话人数据集上，四个冻结TTS模型达到r=0.58-0.63，与零样本ASR和音素基线融合后r从0.698提升至0.757。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配TTS模型学习母语者如何实现文本，但这一知识仅用于合成任务。作者希望利用TTS模型内建的发音知识，无需音频生成即可对非母语学习者的发音质量进行客观评分。
AI.method: 对于学习者话语，在相同噪声输入下，分别计算模型在目标文本和反事实文本（删除或交换单词）下的速度预测误差，两者差异作为生成式发音良好度分数。该信号局限在特定高噪声时间步的窄带中，通过母语音准则定位并用封闭形式规则跨骨干网络迁移。
AI.result: 在SpeechOcean762数据集上（说话人非重叠），四个冻结TTS模型与人工评分的相关系数r=0.58-0.63，与零样本ASR和音素级基线相当。将TTS评分加入基线进行无标签融合后，r从0.698提升至0.757。缓存的帧级别分数还能以零额外TTS成本标记单词级错误。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的TTS模型能够有效用于非母语发音评分，无需语音生成或微调，且与现有ASR基线互补，显著提升评分性能。该方法无需标签即可实现单词级错误检测。

title: Music Circuit: Trace and Control Style Dynamics in Large Music Generation Model
comment: 28 pages, 20 figures, 14 tables
summary: Musical style, a global attribute that functions throughout a whole piece, is a lever widely used by users in modern large music generation models. Yet how style is represented inside these models, and which components drive it, remains largely unexplored. In language models, circuit analysis traces a representation to a sparse sub-network of a few key components, namely attention heads and MLP neurons, and has been used successfully to explain and control global attributes such as emotion. In this work, we use circuit analysis to study the mechanisms behind musical style. Based on YuE2, we build a dataset that pairs the same lyrics with five styles and design a three-step framework. First, stage localization shows that the style forms mainly in the score-planning stage. Second, static observation across the positions of this stage further reveals that style is not a fixed vector but a dynamic representation across tokens. Third, we therefore merge the activation differences across positions into one direction per style, and trace the neurons and attention heads that drive this direction into a sparse circuit. Without any style text, steering this circuit successfully transfers one piece into the target style, matching and even exceeding the style prompt. To our knowledge, this is the first work to analyze and control musical style at the circuit level in a large music generation model. Audio and score examples are available at https://aristo233.github.io/Music_Circuit/.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在大型音乐生成模型YuE2中通过电路分析研究音乐风格的内部表示机制，发现风格主要在乐谱规划阶段形成，是一种跨token的动态表征，通过激活差异融合得到每风格的方向向量，进而提取出驱动该方向的稀疏电路（少量注意力头和MLP神经元），无需风格文本即可成功实现风格迁移。
AI.motivation: 尽管音乐风格是大型音乐生成模型中用户广泛使用的全局属性，但模型内部如何表征风格、哪些组件驱动风格仍未被探索。
AI.method: 基于YuE2模型，构建同一歌词配五种风格的数据集，设计三阶段框架：1）阶段定位（发现风格主要在乐谱规划阶段形成）；2）静态观测（发现风格是跨token的动态表征而非固定向量）；3）融合各位置激活差异得到每风格方向，追溯驱动该方向的注意力头和MLP神经元，形成稀疏电路。
AI.result: 无需风格文本，仅通过操控该稀疏电路即可成功将一段音乐转移到目标风格，效果匹配甚至超越风格提示词。
AI.conclusion: 首次在大型音乐生成模型中实现了电路级别的音乐风格分析、定位与控制，证明了风格由稀疏子网络驱动，并可通过电路干预实现精确的风格迁移。

title: Who Plays What: Same-Instrument Music Separation from Video
summary: When two musicians in an ensemble play the same instrument, they sound alike and their instruments look alike. Audio-only separators, and audio-visual separators that rely on appearance, cannot tell them apart. What still differs is how each player moves, and when. We study same-instrument per-player separation: a user clicks one musician in a video and receives that musician's sound alone, even when other players in the video play the same instrument. Our model follows the clicked player and describes them with high level video features and the velocities of body and hand keypoints. A pretrained music separator attends to these tokens through cross-attention. Earlier motion-based separators were scored only on synthetic mixtures of solo videos. We give the first per-player evaluation of same-instrument separation on real ensemble recordings. On 58 players in URMP, each sharing an instrument with at least one other player in the piece, our model reaches a median SDR of 5.3 dB, while four released separators, audio-only and audio-visual, stay at or below 0.3 dB. The gap is wider on same-instrument duets, and our model also beats the audio-visual baselines on their own MUSIC benchmark. Tests show that the gain comes from movement: replacing the video with a still frame removes it, and so does shifting the video by a fraction of a second against the audio.

AI.tldr: 提出了基于动作特征的同乐器多演奏者声音分离方法，通过点击视频中某位演奏者即可提取该演奏者的声音，在真实合奏录音中达到5.3 dB的中位SDR，远超现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有音频分离和音视频分离方法无法区分同乐器演奏者，因为音色和外观相似。而不同演奏者的动作模式存在差异，可据此实现分离。
AI.method: 用户点击视频中的演奏者，模型提取该演奏者的高层视频特征及身体和手部关键点速度，通过交叉注意力机制让预训练的音乐分离器关注这些动作特征。
AI.result: 在URMP数据集的58位演奏者（每人至少与另一人共享乐器）上达到5.3 dB中位SDR，而四种现有方法仅为0.3 dB或更低；在同乐器二重奏上差距更大；在MUSIC基准上也优于音视频基线。
AI.conclusion: 动作信息是实现同乐器演奏者声音分离的关键：替换为静态帧或音视频时间错位都会导致性能丧失。

title: MusicListenBench: Can Audio LLMs Hear the Difference Yet?
summary: Audio large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on song genre, mood, and instrumentation. A more basic skill is telling whether two short clips play the same melody, chord or instrument. We introduce MusicListenBench, a benchmark of paired listening tests for melody, harmony, timbre, and tempo. Each test item comes with two variants. A FLIP variant changes the music, so the answer must change. A STAY variant changes only the sound, such as room echo or hiss, so the answer must stay the same. The two variants have opposite answers, so a model that ignores the audio scores 50%, whatever letter it prefers. The benchmark has a training split and two test sets, one rendered from symbolic music with exact labels and one built from real recordings. On the rendered test, seven of eight open audio LLMs score within 4 points of this floor. Of four commercial models, both GPT-Audio models are at chance, and the best, Gemini 2.5 Pro, reaches 74.2%, 12.8 points below human listeners (87.0%). Post-training with GRPO on 10k rendered clean pairs raises Qwen2.5-Omni from 61.2% to 99.0% on held-out clean pairs, and the gain transfers to a task left out of training. On FLIP/STAY, however, it only reaches the level of our listeners (86.0%). It now misses almost no change (1.9%, against 24.7% for Gemini 2.5 Pro), yet when only the sound changes, it turns a correct answer into a wrong one 25.7\% of the time. More than half of its false flips come from a quiet background hiss. Models learn to hear a difference much faster than they learn which differences matter. On real recordings, open models again stay near chance, and the trained model calls 27 of 42 pairs of two strums of the same chord different. Adding sound-only pairs to training lowers false flips on both test sets, but no training run teaches relative pitch. We release the data, code, and an open leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出MusicListenBench基准测试，评估音频大模型对旋律、和声、音色和节奏的感知能力。研究发现多数开源和商业模型表现接近随机水平（50%），即使经过强化学习训练的模型也难以区分音乐变化与声音变化，且无法学会相对音高。
AI.motivation: 现有音频大模型评估集中在音乐类型、情感和乐器等高级任务，忽略了更基础的听觉能力——判断两段音频是否演奏相同旋律、和弦或乐器。需要设计专门的测试来评估模型的基础音乐感知能力。
AI.method: 构建MusicListenBench基准，包含配对听力测试，每个测试项有FLIP（音乐变化，答案需变）和STAY（仅声音变化如回声/嘶嘶声，答案需不变）两种变体，使随机猜测准确率为50%。包含符号音乐渲染的精确标签测试集和真实录音测试集，并采用GRPO进行后训练。
AI.result: 8个开源音频LLM中有7个得分在随机水平54%以内；GPT-Audio模型随机水平，Gemini 2.5 Pro达74.2%，低于人类87.0%。GRPO训练后在干净数据上从61.2%提升至99.0%，但在FLIP/STAY测试中仅达86.0%，对声音变化（如背景嘶嘶声）的误判率高达25.7%。
AI.conclusion: 当前音频大模型的基础音乐感知能力严重不足，模型学习

title: ARRANGE: Agentic Skills for Layering Vocals
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Under review at the HUMANE-LLM workshop, ACM IUI 2027 (Helsinki). Code: https://github.com/htansetiawan/ARRANGE ; project page: https://htansetiawan.github.io/ARRANGE
summary: Adding a singing voice to an existing piano recording requires decisions about melody, syllable placement, pronunciation, timing, and vocal register. ARRANGE organizes this work as a sequence of agent skills with readable intermediate artifacts and composer approval checkpoints. An LLM translates instructions in plain English, notes played on a keyboard, and vocal references into local edits; deterministic scripts validate and apply those edits before open audio models render the result. The Score Canvas makes note, syllable, and pronunciation decisions inspectable and editable. In a benchmark of 16 revision requests, three draws per request, and five LLMs, typed edits achieved exact-change correctness of 0.83-0.98, compared with 0.33-0.69 for whole-plan rewriting without ARRANGE instructions. A separate score-editing benchmark and a first-person worked example examine the interaction between representations and corrections. Author listening evaluations further explore voice transfer and register selection, including 185 listening presentations across eight copied voices. These evaluations support the value of constrained editing and expose limits of both model execution and listening measures. The contribution is an interaction architecture for retaining musical decisions through inspectable intermediate representations, rather than a new singing model or evidence of general usability.

AI.tldr: ARRANGE是一种分层交互架构，通过LLM指令翻译、确定性脚本验证和可编辑乐谱画布，在钢琴录音上添加歌声。在16个修订请求的基准测试中，其类型化编辑的精确正确率为0.83-0.98，远超整体重写方法的0.33-0.69。
AI.motivation: 在现有钢琴录音上添加歌声需要协调旋律、音节、发音、时机和声部等多种决策，现有方法缺乏对中间表示的可检查和可编辑能力。
AI.method: 将工作组织为一系列代理技能，包含可读的中间产物和作曲家批准检查点。LLM将自然语言、键盘演奏和声音参考翻译为局部编辑，确定性脚本验证并应用编辑，开放音频模型渲染结果。Score Canvas使得音符、音节和发音决策可检查和可编辑。
AI.result: 在16个修订请求基准测试中（每个请求三次绘图，五种LLM），类型化编辑的精确正确率为0.83-0.98，对比整体重写方法的0.33-0.69。单独的音符编辑基准测试和第一人称工作实例检验了表示与校正之间的交互。作者听力评估涵盖了八种复制声音的185次听力展示。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于通过可检查的中间表示保留音乐决策的交互架构，而非新的歌声模型或通用可用性证据。评估结果支持约束编辑的价值，并揭示了模型执行和听力测量的局限性。

title: Tenlai-TTS 2.0: Continuous-Representation LLM-Based TTS System with End-to-End Training
summary: Autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) with continuous speech latents avoids quantization-induced information loss, but typically relies on a latent space that is learned separately and then frozen before language-model training. Such a space must satisfy two competing requirements: it must retain enough acoustic detail for high-fidelity reconstruction, yet be sufficiently structured and regularized to support autoregressive prediction by a language model. We present Tenlai-TTS 2.0, which learns continuous speech representations through end-to-end training to balance acoustic detail with autoregressive predictability. The model comprises a speech encoder with a capacity-controlled Gaussian bottleneck, a large language model (LLM) with an autoregressive diffusion transformer (AR-DiT) head, a flow-matching (FM) mel-spectrogram decoder, and a multi-task recognition model (RM). With energy normalization and fixed-variance Gaussian noise, the bottleneck has a closed-form upper bound on its information rate. Through joint optimization with reconstruction, recognition, and next-patch prediction objectives, we learn continuous speech representations that suit all three tasks and train the LLM and AR-DiT for autoregressive generation. The LLM and AR-DiT are further optimized using differentiable reconstruction and recognition feedback on their predicted latents through the FM decoder and RM. On Seed-TTS-eval, this feedback-based optimization reduces character error rate (CER) from 0.82% to 0.74% on test-zh and from 8.32% to 7.08% on test-hard-zh, and word error rate (WER) from 1.32% to 1.27% on test-en, compared with joint training alone. Subsequent reinforcement learning further reduces CER to 6.29% on test-hard-zh and WER to 1.08% on test-en, with speaker similarity scores of 0.811, 0.766, and 0.784 on test-zh, test-en, and test-hard-zh, respectively.

AI.tldr: Tenlai-TTS 2.0通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，使用容量控制的高斯瓶颈、自回归扩散Transformer头和流匹配解码器，平衡声学细节与自回归可预测性。联合优化重构、识别和下一片预测目标，并通过可微分的重构与识别反馈进一步优化，在Seed-TTS-eval上显著降低了CER和WER。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归TTS使用连续语音潜在变量虽避免了量化信息损失，但潜在空间需同时满足高保真重构和结构化规则化以支持LM自回归预测这两个竞争性要求，现有方法通常分阶段学习潜在空间然后冻结，未能端到端优化。
AI.method: 提出Tenlai-TTS 2.0，包含：容量控制的高斯瓶颈语音编码器、带自回归扩散Transformer(AR-DiT)头的大语言模型(LLM)、流匹配(FM)梅尔谱解码器、多任务识别模型(RM)。通过能量归一化和固定方差高斯噪声实现信息率闭式上界。采用联合优化(重构+识别+下一片预测)和可微分反馈优化(通过FM解码器和RM对预测潜在变量提供重构和识别梯度)，以及后续强化学习。
AI.result: 在Seed-TTS-eval上，反馈优化相比仅联合训练将test-zh CER从0.82%降至0.74%，test-hard-zh CER从8.32%降至7.08%，test-en WER从1.32%降至1.27%。强化学习进一步将test-hard-zh CER降至6.29%，test-en WER降至1.08%，说话人相似度得分分别为0.811(test-zh)、0.766(test-en)、0.784(test-hard-zh)。
AI.conclusion: Tenlai-TTS 2.0通过端到端学习连续表示平衡声学细节与自回归可预测性，可微分反馈优化和强化学习能有效提升生成质量和说话人相似度，验证了连续潜在空间联合训练优于分离式学习范式。

title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
comment: AAAI 2027 Demonstration Program (accepted). Extended version with appendix
summary: Music creation is inherently iterative, yet many symbolic generation systems still center on producing or regenerating isolated outputs. We present IteraSong, an interactive web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) for LLM-guided iterative symbolic music creation. Unlike one-shot generation systems, IteraSong supports a generate-audition-edit-refine loop over a persistent multi-track project. Users initialize a fully labeled pop draft, then progressively refine it through natural-language instructions. The LLM maps requests to a hierarchical action space of editing primitives exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, spanning global, track, section, and bar/note scopes. The demo enables attendees to edit multi-track compositions in natural language, apply deterministic and generative edits, and undo/redo changes in real time.

AI.tldr: IteraSong是一个基于LLM的交互式数字音频工作站，支持通过自然语言指令进行迭代式符号音乐创作，实现生成-试听-编辑-优化的循环工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有的符号音乐生成系统大多是一次性生成孤立输出，缺乏迭代创作的支持，而音乐创作本质上是迭代过程。
AI.method: 构建了基于Model Context Protocol(MCP)工具的层次化编辑动作空间（全局/音轨/乐段/小节-音符），用户通过自然语言指令驱动LLM映射到具体编辑原语，实现多轨项目的持续迭代。
AI.result: 该演示系统支持用户用自然语言编辑多轨编曲，应用确定性和生成性编辑，并实时进行撤消/重做操作。
AI.conclusion: IteraSong展示了将LLM与DAW结合实现迭代式音乐创作的有效性，为符号音乐生成提供了新范式。

title: Spoof Localization as Boundary Regression
comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Partially spoofed audio embeds spoofed segments in a bonafide utterance, and spoof localization is the task of locating them. Most countermeasures (CMs) operate at the frame level. Typically, they include a front-end representing the audio as frames and a back-end classifying each frame as bonafide or spoof. Such frame-level detection ties the reference, the predictions and the evaluation to a pre-defined temporal resolution: a frame containing a transition receives a single label, a boundary cannot lie inside a frame, and the evaluation also depends on the resolution. To tackle these issues, we treat spoof localization as regression. We propose a single-stage boundary regressor that outputs (start-time, end-time, score) tuples with continuous-valued time stamps, trained on the exact reference intervals. Results show that the proposed CM outperforms previous frame-level and boundary-based CMs, and generalizes better.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将部分伪造音频定位视为回归问题的单阶段边界回归器，直接输出连续时间戳的(开始时间,结束时间,分数)元组，优于现有帧级和边界级方法。
AI.motivation: 现有帧级检测方法存在时间分辨率依赖问题：过渡帧只能分配单一标签、边界无法落在帧内、评估受分辨率影响。
AI.method: 采用单阶段边界回归器，将伪造定位视为回归任务，直接预测连续时间戳的(start-time,end-time,score)元组，使用精确参考区间训练。
AI.result: 提出的方法在性能上优于先前的帧级和基于边界的CM，并且具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将伪造定位转化为回归问题可以有效解决帧级方法的时间分辨率限制，提升检测和泛化性能。

title: From Spatial Perception to Speech Recovery: Binaural Semantic Adaptation for Spatially Grounded Multi-Talker Transcription
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables
summary: Spatial audio large language models increasingly combine general audio understanding with spatial perception. Yet overlapping conversations require more than locating speakers. A model must also recover what each person says and match the words to their positions. We examine this challenge in MiDashengLM-Spatial, a binaural model designed for both spatial reasoning and general audio understanding. To test these abilities, we introduce BiCP-Bench, a benchmark of overlapping two-speaker binaural recordings that contrasts candidate-based recognition, position-guided transcription, and joint transcription with spatial attribution. The model can identify a target utterance among candidates but struggles to transcribe it without them. Its semantic encoder uses only one ear. Changing that ear shifts which side's speech is recovered more accurately, despite unchanged binaural input to the spatial branch. We therefore propose Binaural Semantic Adaptation (BiSA), which combines shared encoding of both ears with cross-ear differential interactions. With the backbone frozen and 0.027% trainable parameters, BiSA raises correctly attributed joint transcription success from 0% to 57.81% for simultaneous onsets. For staggered onsets, later-speaker word error rate falls from 109.47% to 29.58%. On full-length Clarity CEC1 mixtures, word error rate falls from 59.33% to 39.60%. Spatial reasoning on MMAU-Pro improves by 9.54 percentage points without updating the spatial encoder, and general audio performance remains largely intact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双耳语义适配方法（BiSA），通过共享双耳编码和跨耳差分交互，在冻结骨干网络且仅引入0.027%可训练参数的情况下，显著提升双耳空间音频大模型在重叠对话中的联合转录与空间归因能力，同时保持通用音频性能不变。
AI.motivation: 现有空间音频大模型虽能定位声源，但在处理多人重叠对话时，无法同时恢复每位说话人的语音并将其正确匹配到对应空间位置，存在关键的语义-空间关联缺失问题。
AI.method: 提出双耳语义适配（BiSA），包括双耳共享编码和跨耳差分交互两个核心设计，在冻结预训练骨干的前提下仅引入极少量可训练参数。
AI.result: 在BiCP-Bench上，同时起音场景联合转录成功率从0%提升至57.81%；交错起音场景后说话人词错误率从109.47%降至29.58%；在Clarity CEC1上词错误率从59.33%降至39.60%；MMAU-Pro空间推理提升9.54个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 双耳语义适配方法有效解决了空间音频大模型在重叠对话中语义-空间关联的瓶颈，以极低参数代价实现了显著性能提升，且不损害通用音频理解能力。

title: Restorable Multilingual Voice Anonymization via Audio Watermarking
summary: Voice anonymization aims to conceal speaker identity while preserving linguistic and paralinguistic information. However, certain applications also require the ability to attribute anonymized recordings to their original speakers. Existing recovery approaches often rely on specially designed reversible anonymization systems, limiting their applicability to different anonymization architectures. In this work, we propose a post-hoc framework for restorable multilingual voice anonymization that enables speaker attribution without reconstructing the original waveform or modifying the underlying anonymization systems. Specifically, we convert 192-dimensional speaker embeddings into binary identity payloads through sign quantization and embed them into anonymized speech using a segment-wise audio watermarking strategy. Recovered payloads are subsequently matched against enrollment speaker templates for identity attribution. We evaluate the framework across four languages using two distinct anonymization backbones, BM1 and T24. Under clean conditions, the approach achieves approximately 99% exact payload recovery and 0.96% attribution EER while largely preserving the original privacy-utility performance. Experiments further show that speaker attribution remains reliable under several audio distortions despite imperfect payload recovery, although temporal rescaling severely disrupts recovery. Additional analyses reveal that watermark robustness varies across languages, carrier durations, and anonymization backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种后验的多语言语音匿名化可恢复框架，通过符号量化将说话人嵌入转为二进制身份载荷，并采用分段水印嵌入匿名语音，实现说话人归属而不需要修改原始匿名化系统。在两种匿名化骨干和四种语言下，清洁条件下可达约99%载荷恢复与0.96%归属EER，且基本保持原有隐私-效用性能。
AI.motivation: 现有说话人恢复方法通常依赖专门设计的可逆匿名化系统，通用性受限，无法适用于不同匿名化架构。
AI.method: 1) 将192维说话人嵌入经符号量化为二进制身份载荷；2) 采用分段音频水印策略将载荷嵌入匿名化语音；3) 恢复后的载荷与注册说话人模板匹配实现身份归属。
AI.result: 清洁条件下约99%精确载荷恢复和0.96%归属EER；保持原有隐私-效用性能；时间缩放会严重破坏恢复；水印鲁棒性因语言、载波时长和匿名化骨干而异。
AI.conclusion: 该后验框架能在不修改匿名化系统的情况下实现可靠的说话人归属，且在不同语言和匿名化骨干下表现良好。

title: Beyond File-Level Splits: Rethinking Symbolic Music Evaluation via Multi-View Alignment
comment: 14 pages, including the appendix
summary: Symbolic music generation often continues MIDI passages by predicting subsequent notes or events. Held-out prediction loss can overestimate generalization to unseen compositions when training contains another performance or arrangement of a test work. We introduce Multi-View Alignment-Aware Same-Work Identification, combining complementary musical representations with temporal alignment of shared passages to remove test-work versions from training while preserving unrelated material and fixing evaluation files. In a controlled cohort of 100 manually verified pairs selected for high embedding similarity, replacing 3.29% of training windows with test-work versions reduces mean per-group NLL by up to 30.16% relative to matched unrelated content. Across two datasets and two generators, our method brings test losses closest to a reference built from independent work labels. Compared with removing the same number of files at random, it leaves fewer test works exposed and retains more eligible content, including about 99% of eligible tokens on the piano-performance dataset. A separate study on that dataset matches training tokens and updates: no test works remain exposed under the dataset labels, and mean relative test loss is 2.15% higher than an independently selected reference. These findings support keeping all versions of each composition in one split when evaluating generalization to unseen works. The project is available at https://kunbai05-nb.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出多视图对齐感知同作品识别方法，用于在符号音乐生成评估中移除训练集中测试作品的另一版本，解决数据泄露导致的泛化能力高估问题。
AI.motivation: 符号音乐生成中，训练集可能包含测试作品的不同表演或编排版本，这会导致保留预测损失低估模型对全新作品的泛化误差，从而高估模型能力。
AI.method: Multi-View Alignment-Aware Same-Work Identification：结合互补的音乐表示与共享段落的时域对齐，从训练集中移除测试作品版本，同时保留无关材料并修复评估文件。
AI.result: 在100个高嵌入相似度的人工验证对中，替换3.29%的训练窗口使每组NLL相对降低最多30.16%；该方法比随机移除文件暴露更少的测试作品并保留更多内容（钢琴表演数据集约99%令牌）；独立研究显示无测试作品暴露，平均相对测试损失比独立选择参考高2.15%。
AI.conclusion: 支持在评估对未见作品泛化能力时，应将每部作曲的所有版本放在同一个数据划分中。

title: Training speech deepfake detectors against worst-case filters: Gains, Costs and Limits
summary:
Speech deepfake detectors make few errors on standard benchmarks, yet a simple attack defeats them: the attacker passes fake speech through one short filter, tuned against the detector, and many fakes then pass as real. Training with random filters does not stop this attack, because the attacker uses the worst filter, not a random one.
  We therefore train the detector against the worst case: during training, a small set of filters is updated to fool the current detector, at about the cost of random filters. In a preregistered study, this made the detector more robust to filter attacks on real-world recordings than random filters did. It also lowered the in-domain attack error of the standard detector, and beat one-step adversarial training with additive noise on real-world recordings. The price is a higher error on unfiltered speech, and a validation study shows that choosing the checkpoint on held-out spoofing systems made the standard detector about as robust.

AI.tldr: 针对语音深度伪造检测器易受简单滤波器攻击的问题，提出在训练过程中动态更新一小组合适的滤波器以模拟最坏情况，从而提升检测器对滤波器攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准检测器在基准测试中表现优异，但极易被一种简单攻击方式击败：攻击者仅需通过一个针对检测器的短滤波器，大量伪造语音即可被误判为真实。训练时使用随机滤波器无法抵御此攻击，因为攻击者会使用最差滤波器而非随机滤波器。
AI.method: 在训练过程中，持续更新一小组合适的滤波器以欺骗当前检测器（模拟最坏情况），其计算成本与随机滤波器相近。
AI.result: 预先注册的研究表明，该方法在真实场景录音上比随机滤波器更鲁棒；降低了标准检测器的域内攻击错误率；在真实录音上优于带加性噪声的一步对抗训练。代价是对未滤波语音的误判率升高。
AI.conclusion: 验证研究显示，若在保留的欺骗系统上选择检查点，标准检测器几乎能达到同等鲁棒性，但本文方法在对抗滤波器攻击方面具有优势。

title: PopMelodyGen: A Copyright-Aware Platform for Controllable Pop-Melody Generation
comment: AAAI 2027 Demonstration Program (accepted); extended version with appendix
summary: Large-scale redistributable symbolic pop-melody data remain scarce due to copyright restrictions, creating a bottleneck for both practical deployment and reproducible research in music generation. We present PopMelodyGen, a copyright-aware platform for controllable pop-melody generation that combines rule-based synthesis with neural generation. Our approach first uses an expert synthesizer to produce large-scale labeled synthetic melodies from explicit musical knowledge and templates, providing scalable pretraining data with auditable provenance. A neural model is then pretrained on this corpus and adapted with a small licensed real-pop corpus to improve melodic naturalness while preserving controllability. The platform supports interactive melody creation with accompaniment playback and export for creators, as well as batch construction of annotated symbolic datasets for researchers. PopMelodyGen demonstrates a practical training and deployment paradigm for creative AI when large-scale reusable real-world data are limited.

AI.tldr: 提出了PopMelodyGen，一个结合规则合成与神经生成的可控旋律生成平台。先用专家合成器生成大规模有标签合成旋律进行预训练，再用少量授权真实流行音乐数据微调，以解决版权导致的旋律数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 受版权限制，大规模可再分配的符号化流行旋律数据稀缺，阻碍了音乐生成的实用部署和可复现研究。
AI.method: 1) 利用专家合成器基于显式音乐知识与模板生成大规模有标签合成旋律（可审计溯源）；2) 在该语料上预训练神经模型；3) 用少量授权真实流行音乐语料微调，平衡自然度与可控性。
AI.result: 实现了支持交互式旋律创作（含伴奏回放与导出）和批量构建带标注符号数据集的平台。
AI.conclusion: PopMelodyGen为大规模真实数据受限的创意AI提供了一种实用的训练与部署范式。

title: SoundFleXR: Selectively Constraining Axes of Audio Rendering Presentations
summary: Extended reality (XR) systems increasingly rely on audio cues to help users locate, interpret, and interact with virtual content, especially when the content is outside the field of view. To support this, many systems use head-related transfer functions (HRTFs) to approximate real-world acoustics. However, a realistic simulation is only one possible presentation. Audio can also be altered by constraining, flexing, or contracting the spatial dimensions represented in the signal. This work examines how selectively constraining or flexing the number of audio dimensions affects localization performance across XR task structures with different spatial degrees of freedom. We compare two-channel spatial audio, azimuth-only HRTF, and full HRTF rendering across orientation-based (3DoF) and translation-based (6DoF) tasks. Azimuth-only HRTF was mutually non-inferior to full HRTF for total angular error across task conditions, including at the strictest tested tolerance in 3DoF (5 degrees), and remained comparable for azimuth error at (10 degrees) and larger tolerances in both 3DoF and 6DoF. In contrast, two-channel stereo required coarser tolerances to reach non-inferiority, becoming comparable to full HRTF for 6DoF azimuth error at (15 degrees) but not (10 degrees). From these comparisons, we derive design lessons and application scenarios that indicate when fewer spatial cues provide sufficient support and when richer spatial cues are beneficial.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在扩展现实（XR）系统中，选择性约束或弯曲音频空间维度（双声道立体声、仅方位角HRTF、全HRTF）对用户定位性能的影响。实验覆盖3DoF和6DoF任务，发现仅方位角HRTF在总角度误差上不劣于全HRTF，而双声道立体声需更宽松的容忍度才能达到同等效果。基于此提出了空间音频设计的应用准则。
AI.motivation: 扩展现实系统常用HRTF模拟真实声学环境，但音频呈现不一定需要完全逼真。研究者希望探究通过约束空间维度（减少音频通道或方位信息）是否仍能有效支持用户定位，从而为不同任务结构（3DoF/6DoF）提供更高效的音频设计指导。
AI.method: 通过用户实验比较三种音频渲染方式：双声道立体声、仅方位角HRTF、全HRTF。实验任务分为3DoF（仅朝向）和6DoF（带平移）两类，测量总角度误差和方位角误差，采用非劣效性检验分析不同容忍度下的表现。
AI.result: 仅方位角HRTF在3DoF（5°容忍度）和6DoF（10°容忍度）下与全HRTF非劣效；双声道立体声仅在6DoF方位角误差15°容忍度时达到非劣效，10°时未达标。
AI.conclusion: 在不同空间自由度的XR任务中，仅方位角HRTF可作为高保真全HRTF的有效替代方案，而双声道立体声仅在定位精度要求较低时适用。研究结果可指导开发者根据任务需求选择适当层级的空间音频。

title: REMORA: A Voice-First Memory Assistant for Grounded Personal Recall and Independent Living
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables
summary: Most of what matters in a day is spoken and written down nowhere: a dosing interval named at a clinic, a deadline moved in passing, the place a document was set down. Such information is consequential because it is operational, and fragile because it arrives during divided attention -- the moment its importance becomes clear is rarely the moment it was said. For people living with mild cognitive impairment, Alzheimer's disease or age-related episodic memory decline, that gap bounds independent living. Conventional aids close it poorly: notes, reminders and calendars require the user to notice, interrupt and transcribe, adding extraneous cognitive load exactly where attention is already committed. We present REMORA, a voice-first memory assistant that converts consented speech into structured, auditable memory records. REMORA transcribes and diarizes captured audio, extracts memory candidates -- tasks, appointments, names, instructions, object locations -- each retaining provenance into the conversation it came from, and holds records, embeddings and relationships in a single relational system of record. Recall combines lexical, semantic, relational and recency signals, since no one signal covers the ways people interrogate their own past, and reaches the user either through an explicit query or through a confidence-gated cue that stays silent unless it is likely to help. Generation is bound by a grounding contract: only retrieved evidence may be used, and absent a supporting memory REMORA abstains rather than confabulates, because a fluent invention about one's own past will be acted upon as fact. A requirements survey and a pilot study with memory-loss users indicate that conversational forgetting extends well beyond clinical populations, that grounded and concise recall is feasible in controlled settings, and that privacy, rather than accuracy, is the binding constraint on adoption.

AI.tldr: REMORA是一个语音优先的记忆辅助系统，能够将用户授权捕获的语音转化为结构化的可审计记忆记录，通过结合多种检索信号实现准确回忆，并在缺乏证据时选择不回答而非虚构，以帮助轻度认知障碍、阿尔茨海默病或年龄相关记忆衰退患者应对日常信息遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 日常生活中的多数重要信息（如用药间隔、截止日期、物品位置）仅在口头交流中传递，且常在注意力分散时出现。对于存在记忆障碍的人群，这种信息间隙限制了独立生活能力。现有辅助手段（笔记、提醒、日历）要求用户主动注意、中断当前活动并转录，增加了认知负荷。
AI.method: REMORA包含以下核心模块：1) 语音转录与说话人分离；2) 提取记忆候选（任务、约会、名称、指令、物品位置）并保留来源溯源；3) 在同一关系型记录系统中存储记录、嵌入向量和关系；4) 结合词汇、语义、关系和时效性信号进行回忆；5) 通过显式查询或置信度门控的主动提示触达用户；6) 采用'接地契约'——仅使用检索到的证据生成回答，无支持记忆时拒绝回答。
AI.result: 需求调查和初步用户研究显示：1) 对话遗忘现象远超临床人群；2) 在受控环境中，接地且简洁的回忆是可行的；3) 隐私（而非准确性）是采用的决定性约束。
AI.conclusion: REMORA展示了语音辅助记忆系统的可行设计空间，但其实际应用受限于隐私问题而非技术准确性。

title: LightOnOCR for AMNLT: Reading Chant Notation and Lyrics in One Pass, from Single Staves to Whole Pages
summary: Aligned music notation and lyrics transcription (AMNLT) asks for the notes of a chant, its sung text and the assignment of syllables to notes in one output. Fuentes-Martínez et al., who defined the task, found that the one vision-language model they tested fell far behind specialised recognisers. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B, a page OCR model with one billion parameters, end to end, vision encoder included, to write a staff as a GABC string whose letters denote staff positions. Trained on the published AMNLT training split alone, it more than halves the best published aligned music and lyrics error rate (AMLER) on Solesmes, the one directly comparable dataset (9.9 against 21.0 %); on Einsiedeln and Salzinnes, measured in a different encoding, its figures are also lower. The benchmark does not measure generalisation to unseen manuscripts: while the pitch error on AMNLT validation stays between 1.7 and 1.9 %, on 200 staves from five unseen manuscripts it falls from 24.9 to 1.3 % as we add chant aligned through CantusDB, Transkribus ground truth and silver staves kept only where two readers agree. Trained also on multi-staff images, it reads whole pages without staff detection (pitch error 3.3 to 3.8 % on validation and test pages, 1.9 % on pages of unseen manuscripts). Remaining errors include Gothic F clefs read as C clefs, notes dropped with abbreviated or illegible text and lower accuracy on pages with small notation. Controlled ablations are needed to explain the gains.

AI.tldr: 微调页面OCR模型LightOnOCR-3-1B（10亿参数）进行对齐音乐符号与歌词转录（AMNLT），在Solesmes数据集上使最佳对齐音乐与歌词错误率从21.0%降至9.9%，在未见手稿上的音高错误率从24.9%降至1.3%，并能直接读取整页乐谱。
AI.motivation: 此前视觉-语言模型在AMNLT任务上远落后于专用识别器，作者希望探索通用OCR模型在该任务上的潜力。
AI.method: 端到端微调LightOnOCR-3-1B（包括视觉编码器），将谱表输出为GABC字符串；训练数据包括AMNLT标准分割、CantusDB对齐吟唱、Transkribus标注以及多读者一致的银标数据。
AI.result: 在Solesmes上AMLER从21.0%降至9.9%；在Einsiedeln和Salzinnes上也更低。未见手稿音高错误率从24.9%降至1.3%。多谱表图像整页识别音高错误率3.3-3.8%。
AI.conclusion: 微调页面OCR模型在AMNLT上显著超越此前最佳结果，但仍有部分系统性错误（如Gothic F谱号误读为C谱号），需控制消融实验进一步解释提升原因。

title: Beyond Raw IQ: Compact Semantic Representations for Task Oriented Automatic Modulation Classification
comment: 14 pages
summary: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is an important component of modern wireless communication systems, but conventional signal representations can be expensive to store, process, and communicate, particularly under noisy channel conditions. This work investigates whether learned semantic representations can provide a compact alternative to high-dimensional in-phase and quadrature (IQ) representations while retaining robustness to noise. Starting from a 2048-dimensional IQ representation, we evaluate learned semantic representations with dimensions of 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. Across the evaluated configurations, a 16-dimensional representation provides the strongest overall trade-off between classification performance, robustness, and representation size. The resulting representation achieves a 128x compression ratio and a 99.22% reduction in dimensionality. We further evaluate representation stability across signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), compare semantic representations with a raw-IQ CNN, analyze per-class robustness, and perform five-seed validation. The five-seed evaluation produces an average accuracy of (49.22 +- 0.52)% and Macro-F1 of (49.27 +- 0.53)% across the evaluated SNR range. These results indicate that learned semantic compression can produce a substan- tially smaller representation while preserving useful classification information and improving geometric stability under noise.

AI.tldr: 本文探索使用4到64维的语义表示替代传统的2048维IQ表示进行自动调制分类，发现16维表示在分类性能、鲁棒性和压缩率之间达到最优，实现了128倍压缩比和99.22%的维度缩减。
AI.motivation: 传统IQ信号表示在高维度和噪声环境下存储、处理和通信成本高，亟需更紧凑且鲁棒性强的替代方案。
AI.method: 从2048维IQ表示出发，评估4/8/16/32/64维的语义表示；在多个SNR下分析分类性能、鲁棒性、表示稳定性，并与原始IQ-CNN对比；进行五种子验证。
AI.result: 16维表示实现128倍压缩与99.22%维度缩减；五种子验证在评估SNR范围内平均准确率(49.22±0.52)%，Macro-F1 (49.27±0.53)%。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的语义压缩能在大幅减小表示尺寸的同时保留有用分类信息，并提升噪声下的几何稳定性。

title: When Being Wrong Is Right: Reverse-Capability Audio CAPTCHAs through Psychoacoustic Design
comment: 18 pages
summary:
Large audio-language models (LALMs) have recently been shown to bypass audio CAPTCHAs designed around limitations of automatic speech recognition. To address this threat, we introduce reverse-capability verification, a general CAPTCHA framework that reverses the conventional human-easy, machine-hard relationship with respect to the physical ground truth. It selects challenges in which stable human perceptual limitations cause the human-reference answer to differ from the physical ground truth, while machine analysis tends toward that truth. Because the verifier accepts the human-reference answer, advanced solver capabilities and resulting improved recovery of the physical ground truth may instead strengthen the human-machine separation.
  We instantiate the framework through psychoacoustics and design two audio CAPTCHAs: HIPI, a classification task, and YINGCHEN, a counting task, together with their conjunctive composition. Across seven LALMs and eight attack strategies, the maximum observed machine acceptance rates are 19%, 17%, and 3% for HIPI, YINGCHEN, and their composition, respectively, compared with 45-100% for nine prior schemes. A multidimensional human usability study yields corresponding human acceptance rates of 78%, 90%, and 76%, while maintaining competitive efficiency and satisfaction. Further analysis demonstrates that advanced LALMs tend toward physical ground truth. These results show that reverse-capability verification substantially reduces machine acceptance while retaining high human acceptance through an approach different from conventional CAPTCHAs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种逆向能力验证（reverse-capability verification）的通用CAPTCHA框架，通过利用人类感觉限制（如听觉错觉）来区分人类与机器。基于该框架设计了两个音频CAPTCHA（HIPI和YINGCHEN），实验表明其对LALMs的机器接受率极低（最高19%），而人类接受率高（76-90%），远超现有方案。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）已经能够绕过基于自动语音识别（ASR）局限的传统音频CAPTCHA，亟需一种新的防御机制。
AI.method: 提出逆向能力验证框架，利用人类稳定的感知限制（如心理声学现象）使人类参考答案偏离物理真相，而机器分析趋向于物理真相；基于此设计了分类任务HIPI和计数任务YINGCHEN及其组合。
AI.result: 在7个LALM和8种攻击策略下，HIPI、YINGCHEN及其组合的最高机器接受率分别为19%、17%和3%，而人类接受率分别为78%、90%和76%；且证明高级LALMs更倾向于物理真相。
AI.conclusion: 逆向能力验证通过不同于传统CAPTCHA的方法，大幅降低了机器接受率同时保持高人类接受率，有效抵御LALMs攻击。

title: StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://openraiser.github.io/StudioBench/ and code: https://github.com/openraiser/StudioBench . Equal contribution: Xinglong Xu, Yuxia Zhu. Corresponding authors: Asher Qin, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan
summary: Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and composition, object structure, motion, and lip sync. All models spontaneously organize multi-stage production workflows without predefined templates. However, higher-quality models exhibit more selective production workflows, whereas additional tool calls alone show little association with quality. These findings identify the missing quality loop of effective inspection, selection, and revision as a key bottleneck in productive audiovisual creation.

AI.tldr: StudioBench是一个包含160个任务、覆盖8种视频类型和5种任务类型的基准测试，用于评估通用多模态大模型在端到端音视频创作中的表现。研究发现，在7个MLLM中，显式要求基本饱和，但画质、构图、物体结构、动态和口型同步等质量指标存在显著差异。高质量模型展现出更具选择性的生产流程，而仅增加工具调用与质量关联甚微。有效检查、选择和修订的质量循环缺失是生产力音视频创作的关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试聚焦于单个生成器或视频代理在更狭义的生产设置下的表现，而通用多模态大模型在端到端音视频创作方面的潜力尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 构建包含160个任务、8种视频类型和5种任务类型的StudioBench基准，模型使用33种原子生成、编辑和检查工具，在无shell访问或工作流模板的情况下生成数分钟的成品音视频内容。通过分析重构的工作流图评估交付影片并诊断故障。
AI.result: 在7个MLLM中，显式要求几乎饱和，但画质、构图、物体结构、动态和口型同步等生产质量差异显著。所有模型均自发组织多阶段生产工作流。高质量模型展现出更具选择性的生产流程，而额外工具调用与质量关联很小。
AI.conclusion: 有效检查、选择和修订的质量循环缺失是生产力音视频创作的关键瓶颈。

title: CANDOR: A Multilingual Provenance-Documented Corpus for Dysarthric Speech Research
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Language Resources and Evaluation
summary: CANDOR assembles 61 corpora across 17 languages and five aetiological classes plus a mixed/other group. Its register counts 2,057 speakers classified as dysarthric and 19,538 healthy controls. The collection contains 4,469.7 hours of audio, including 1,178.8 hours in the dysarthric subset. Counts use speech-impairment labels where available and diagnosis labels otherwise. The collection includes 732 dysarthric speakers across 14 non-English languages; 194 speakers use six languages unsupported by Qwen3-ASR, the model underlying its non-English baselines. We document composition, chain of custody, licences and transfer terms, while distinguishing corpus-level provenance from participant-level consent records, which we hold for few constituents. Among 31 dysarthric-bearing corpora, open licences cover 29.0% of corpora, 10.5% of speakers and 8.2% of hours. Excluding the English Speech Accessibility Project raises the open hour share to 31.2%, showing its dependence on this collection's composition. CANDOR cannot be redistributed as a single audio resource; we specify public, restricted and conditional artefacts. Severity labels available in 15 corpora do not provide a validated cross-corpus mapping. Within the non-English ASR baselines, only Mandarin yields a real-speech estimate meeting our evaluation criteria. It differs sharply from the synthesis result and remains imprecise; an English challenge result uses a different model and protocol. CANDOR provides a documented basis for research on under-represented languages while making constraints on evaluation, comparability and sharing explicit.

AI.tldr: CANDOR 是一个涵盖17种语言、61个语料库的综合性语音数据集，包含2057名构音障碍患者和19538名健康对照的音频数据。它记录了语料库的组成、来源、许可协议等元数据，但无法作为单一音频资源重新分发。非英语ASR基线中仅普通话达到评估标准，数据集明确指出了评估、可比性和共享方面的限制。
AI.motivation: 为构音障碍语音研究提供一个大规模、多语言、多病因类型的整合数据集，并透明记录其组成、许可和共享限制，特别关注非英语和低资源语言的代表性。
AI.method: 收集61个语料库，涵盖17种语言和5种病因类别，总计4469.7小时音频（其中构音障碍子集1178.8小时）。使用语音障碍标签（如有）或诊断标签进行分类，并记录语料库级来源和参与者级同意记录。
AI.result: 构建了包含2057名构音障碍患者和19538名健康对照的数据集，开放许可覆盖31个构音障碍语料库中的29.0%的语料库、10.5%的说话人和8.2%的音频小时。非英语ASR基线中仅普通话达到评估标准，且与合成结果存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: CANDOR为低资源语言研究提供了有文档依据的基础，同时明确指出了在评估、可比性和共享方面的约束条件，强调了数据集无法作为单一音频资源重新分发的限制。

title: PAWP-TTS: Phoneme-Aware Weight Programming for Compact Bilingual English-Nepali Speech Synthesis
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/Firojpaudel/PAWP_TTS | Audio Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Firoj112/pawp-tts-demo | Models: https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-1.5m and https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-300k
summary: This paper presents PAWP-TTS, a compact non-autoregressive text-to-speech system for English, Nepali, and English-Nepali code-mixed speech at 24 kHz, with no language model at inference. Deterministic pronunciation knowledge lives in a rule- and lexicon-based bilingual frontend that preserves native Nepali contrasts and avoids Hindi phonology, so the network only models acoustics. Counting every learned inference tensor, including the waveform decoder, PAWP-1.5M (1,490,390 parameters, 5.98 MB) reaches 1.50% English and 1.75% Nepali character error rate under a single ASR recognizer, and 5.04% / 4.02% Nepali / English phoneme error rate (PER) on 600 untouched test utterances. Decoder-centric 281K-parameter models (1.1 MB) stay intelligible across three independent seeds, with equal-budget dense models (5.53 +/- 0.08% NE, 5.34 +/- 0.28% EN PER) outperforming K=2 cross-layer shared-basis models (6.35 +/- 0.11% NE, 6.57 +/- 0.47% EN PER). Fixing a frontend/label version mismatch nearly halved Nepali PER, more than any architectural or weight-level change. The paper then studies weight-space programming: inspection-guided, zero-training weight edits. Under strict controls (validation-only selection, one-shot test, paired bootstrap, matched random and same-parameter gradient baselines), edits show real selectivity (27:1 on word-boundary pauses with 96 weights; zero cross-lingual collateral inside language-gated residuals) but no accuracy gain beyond controls. Two apparent targets proved to be label or phonology artifacts. Code, ONNX graphs, and CC BY 4.0 weights are released.

AI.tldr: PAWP-TTS是一个紧凑的非自回归文本到语音系统，支持英语、尼泊尔语及混合语种，24kHz采样，推理时无需语言模型。仅149万参数，通过规则/词典前端避免神经网络学习音系，在ASR测试中达到低错误率。研究发现权重空间编程（零训练编辑）虽具选择性但无准确率提升，并揭示了标注伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 在低资源语言（如尼泊尔语）及代码混合场景中，现有TTS系统常过度依赖神经网络学习语言学知识，导致数据需求高、跨语言迁移困难。作者试图通过将确定性发音知识（规则/词典）前置到前端，大幅压缩网络规模，并探索零训练权重编辑的有效性。
AI.method: 1）设计双语前端（规则+词典）处理英语/尼泊尔语音系对比，避免引入印地语音系；2）构建PAWP-1.5M非自回归TTS架构（含波形解码器仅149万参数）；3）进行权重空间编程实验：基于梯度/随机基线，检验人工权重编辑对输出选择性的影响；4）严格对照验证：验证集选择、一次性测试、配对bootstrap、随机参数基线。
AI.result: 1）PAWP-1.5M在ASR测试中：英语CER 1.50%、尼泊尔语CER 1.75%；PER分别为4.02%（尼）/5.04%（英）；2）281K参数解码器模型保持可懂度，密集模型优于K=2跨层共享基模型；3）修复前端/标签版本不匹配使尼泊尔PER降低近半；4）权重编辑虽具选择性（27:1词边界停顿比，96权重，零跨语言副作用），但无准确率提升，两个表观目标被证实为标注/音系伪影。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑型非自回归TTS在低资源场景可行，但权重空间编程（零训练编辑）无法超越简单基线；研究强调严格的对照实验和伪影检测对小规模TTS研究的必要性。论文开源了代码、ONNX图和CC BY 4.0权重。

title: Ultrasound Watermark: Real-time Acoustic Watermarking against Voice Scams on Smartphones
summary: Recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS), voice conversion (VC), and AI-driven speech synthesis enable adversaries to convincingly impersonate trusted individuals during phone calls. Existing defenses often rely on offline analysis, degrade under telephony distortions, or remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks. To address these limitations, we present Ultrasound Watermark, a real-time, smartphone-native framework that protects live calls by binding speech to the caller's physical articulatory motion through acoustic watermarking. During a call, the smartphone emits ultrasonic signals and captures reflections from facial articulatory movements using only its built-in speaker and microphone. Ultrasound Watermark extracts motion features from these reflections and fuses them with outgoing speech to generate a dynamic watermark. Because the ultrasonic measurements are physically and temporally coupled with speech production, they are difficult to spoof without the underlying articulatory motion. A synchronized generator-detector architecture enforces cross-modal speech-motion consistency against replay, synthesized speech, and articulation-mimicking attacks. Ultrasound Watermark operates continuously with less than 200 ms latency overhead and requires no additional hardware. We implement Ultrasound Watermark on iOS and Android and evaluate it using over 2.5 hours of synchronized speech-ultrasound recordings from 22 speakers across eight smartphones and four real-world environments. Results demonstrate robustness to diverse attacks and telephony distortions while preserving perceptual audio quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ultrasound Watermark，一种实时、仅需智能手机的框架，通过超声波反射捕捉面部发音运动并生成动态水印，在通话中验证语音与说话者物理运动的一致性，抵御重放、合成语音等攻击。在22位说话者、8款手机上验证，延迟<200ms，鲁棒且不损害感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有语音伪造防御（如离线分析、抗电话失真方法）在实时性、鲁棒性和抗自适应攻击方面存在局限，需要一种轻量、实时、与物理运动绑定的通话保护方案。
AI.method: 通话时手机扬声器发射超声波，麦克风捕获面部发音运动的反射信号；提取运动特征并与输出语音融合生成动态水印；采用同步生成器-检测器架构，强制跨模态（语音-运动）一致性以抵御重放、合成语音和模仿发音运动攻击。
AI.result: iOS/Android原型测试2.5小时以上同步数据，22位说话者、8款手机、4种真实环境；延迟<200ms，无需额外硬件；对多种攻击和电话失真具有鲁棒性，保持感知音频质量。
AI.conclusion: Ultrasound Watermark 是首个仅用智能手机内置组件实现实时、物理绑定语音验证的框架，有效弥补了现有防御在实时性和抗攻击性上的不足。

title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出音频-视觉重新排列（AVR）任务，要求智能体根据语音指令检索并递送物体至指定地点；构建了涵盖三类查询、八种子类型的数据集，并提出融合运动感知空间音频模块的音频-视觉大语言模型框架，通过多任务指令调优提升动作预测能力。
AI.motivation: 当前具身智能研究缺乏结合听觉定位、语音理解与视觉抓取的综合性任务，现有方法难以处理复杂空间语音指令和移动中的声源定位问题。
AI.method: 提出AVR任务及数据集，设计融合运动感知空间音频模块的音频-视觉大语言模型，通过多任务指令调优加入语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉基础定位的辅助监督。
AI.result: 在已知和未知环境中建立了基线性能，验证了所提框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AVR任务为具身智能与人机交互研究提供了新基准，未来可在此基础上探索更复杂的语音引导操作场景。

title: Synthetic Twins: Closing the Gap Between TTS Test Sets and Real Recordings in Turkish ASR Evaluation
summary: Speech synthesized by text-to-speech engines is a low-cost substitute for recorded test sets in automatic speech recognition, yet an off-the-shelf synthetic test set is worth only a few dozen real recordings for estimating the real error rate of a recognizer. This paper examines which properties of real recordings are missing from synthetic speech and how much of the gap can be closed. For 507 Turkish Common Voice recordings, synthetic twins are built: a ladder of synthetic copies that adds, one factor at a time, the pitch of the speaker, a clone of the same speaker, the real recording channel and the speaking rate. At each step, the agreement between ASR behaviour on the copy and on the real recording is measured. Across three zero-shot cloning engines and panels of six and 19 recognizers, the speaker clone is the step that improves agreement on which sentences are hard, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55 for Chatterbox. Matching the channel or adding generic noise corrects the error level when the synthetic speech is easier than real speech. The twin with the highest worth is equivalent to 70 to 122 real recordings, depending on the recognizer panel, compared with about 9 for a stock voice. The findings replicate on VoxForge, a second corpus in which speaker identity is known rather than inferred: the clone raises sentence agreement from .31 to .50 and the worth from 8 to about 50 recordings. Agreement on which sentences are hard is distinct from agreement on how hard they are. The paper concludes with a practical recipe and a reporting checklist for synthetic ASR test sets.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何通过构建合成语音的“双胞胎”（逐步添加音高、说话人克隆、录音信道、语速等特征）来缩小合成语音与真实录音在自动语音识别（ASR）评估中的差距，发现说话人克隆是提升句子难度一致性最关键的因素，最佳合成副本可等效于70–122条真实录音。
AI.motivation: TTS合成的语音虽然成本低，但直接用于ASR测试时，其估计真实错误率的有效性有限（仅相当于几十条真实录音），需要探索合成语音缺失了真实录音的哪些特性，以及如何弥补这些差距。
AI.method: 基于507条土耳其语Common Voice录音，逐步构建合成“双胞胎”（依次添加说话人音高、说话人克隆、信道、语速）；使用三种零样本克隆引擎和多个ASR识别器（6和19个）测量合成副本与真实录音在行为一致性上的变化，并在VoxForge语料库上验证。
AI.result: 说话人克隆是提升句子难度一致性（Spearman相关系数从.41提升到.55）的关键步骤；匹配信道或添加噪声可修正错误率水平；最佳合成副本的等效价值从约9条真实录音（默认语音）提升到70–122条；在VoxForge上验证了类似效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统化地匹配说话人、信道等属性，合成测试集可以显著缩小与真实录音的差距；论文最后给出了实用的合成测试集构建方案和报告清单。
